title: Queer History and Underground Tour
requirements: Travelers should have at least a moderate level of physical fitness
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Come take an enjoyable and educational tour visiting the underground and learning about the early Queer history and activism in Seattle's Pioneer Square. How did Seattle become so queer friendly? Did you know before Capitol Hill was the big gayborhood, Pioneer Square was the hot spot of early queer culture and activism?
